name: CredentialAssignment
description:
CredentialAssignment gives one requirement its value on a surface that starts runs.

 Schedules, share links, channels and platform clients start runs with no
 person whose own credentials could be used, so they carry the values
 their runs need as assignments.

fields.name: Credential
fields.description: A field of a credential the writer may use.

fields.name: Literal
fields.description: A plain value written on the surface itself; never a secret.

fields.name: Writer
fields.description: The identity account that wrote this assignment. Set by the server.
